task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the official Department of Energy website (energy.gov).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'https://www.energy.gov/' and the page content displays the DOE logo and official banner.

task_completion.description: The agent opens Developer Tools and selects the iPhone 12 Pro device emulation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser UI shows the device toolbar active with 'iPhone 12 Pro' selected in the dropdown menu.

task_completion.description: The website renders in a mobile-responsive view consistent with a narrow viewport.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The navigation menu is collapsed into a 'hamburger' icon and content is stacked vertically to fit the narrow width.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates a full-size/full-page screenshot of the entire page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen selecting 'Capture full size screenshot' from the DevTools command menu or a similar tool-specific action.

task_completion.description: The resulting image is saved to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/energy_mobile_audit.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or terminal output confirms the file 'energy_mobile_audit.png' exists on the Desktop.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the browser GUI rather than just using CLI tools to download the page.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor moving, clicking menus, and the browser window being active.

integrity.description: The agent used the built-in browser emulation features rather than just resizing a desktop window.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Device Mode overlay (showing resolution and scale) is visible in the browser viewport.

integrity.description: The final saved image contains actual content from energy.gov, not a blank or placeholder file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The saved file preview shows the actual Department of Energy homepage content.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The iPhone 12 Pro has a CSS viewport width of 390px. The full-page screenshot should have a width of 390px (or multiples like 780px/1170px depending on DPR) and a height significantly greater than 1500px to capture the full length of the energy.gov homepage. The target URL is https://www.energy.gov/ and the required output path is /home/ga/Desktop/energy_mobile_audit.png.
